_doc: Profile bulk: RACE-BIND-C4-BULK checkpoint 1, the race-load C4 census list (was verify/bindbulk_20261121/tools/bulk_bind_gen.py + regen.py + refs_gen.py, kept there as history). Folded in by BIND-BULK-PROFILE 2026-11-21. Binds only the listed roots (roots.txt, 362 rvas); a root with an exe body is reused; a matched callee outside the list is a named stop; a body another profile bound wins over every stop (bound_wins). Its wrappers keep a PortTop_Keep_<rva> anchor; the raceload profile's refs step owns Match/PortTop_BulkRefs.cpp (foreign_keep_marks there). After `write --profile bulk` run `refs --profile raceload` and `sync --profile bulk`.
